name: 44514 · Poland, OH
findings: ZIP 44514 (Poland) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44514 (Poland) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44514 (Poland) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).
